extracted.intended_audience: administrative law researchers, librarians, practitioners, and anyone seeking ACUS publications and recommendations
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled, annotated bibliography of publications (reports, articles, papers, transcripts) wholly or partially funded or sponsored by the Administrative Conference of the United States (ACUS), and works by ACUS chairs and staff, covering 1968 through October 31, 2005 (with some later publication activity noted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: This bibliography is a list of reports, articles, and papers wholly or partially funded or sponsored by the Administrative Conference, or written by ACUS Chairs and staff members throughout its existence from 1968 to October 31, 2005. (Some entries also reflect continued publication activity beyond October 1995.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes reports written by consultants performing research for the Conference, guides, sourcebooks, manuals prepared by Office of the Chairman staff, journal articles written by staff, published transcripts of colloquia, seminars and other meetings, and papers prepared by committees or working groups. Many reports were also reprinted privately, so titles vary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annotation for recommendation-linked reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries for reports that lead to a recommendation contain an annotation with additional bibliographic information about the recommendation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Associated Recommendations themselves can be found in the Federal Register, the Annual Report of the Administrative Conference for the year of adoption, and in the Code of Federal Regulations through 1993. The bibliography gives both original and renumbered recommendation identifiers for clarity (the first 35 recommendations were re-numbered in 1973; though they should be cited in the renumbered format, both versions are given here). Note: due to budget constraints only the titles, not the text, of recommendations were printed in the CFR in 1994 and 1995.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title usage rule
rubrics_metrics.description: The titles used for this bibliography are the titles that appear in ACUS’s series, Recommendations and Reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All known published versions are noted in each entry. Because many reports were reprinted privately, titles may vary and the bibliography records those variants where known.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transcripts and indexes placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Transcripts of meetings are listed separately, by date, at the end of the bibliography; subject and author indexes are also included at the end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the end sections of the bibliography for chronological transcripts and for subject and author indexes that facilitate locating items by topic or author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporal coverage and exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary coverage period is 1968 through October 31, 2005; some entries reflect continued publication activity beyond October 1995.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The bibliography notes edition/printing details (e.g., 1st ed., 2d ed., revised ed.) and identifies later internet editions or reprints where available (examples in entries show citations to later Internet editions or reprints and cross-references to articles published elsewhere).

rubrics_metrics.name: Repository and access/contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: With the closing of the Administrative Conference on October 31, 1995, the items in this bibliography, Research Program files, and copies of Plenary Session transcripts have been donated to the Pence Law Library, Washington College of Law, American University, 4801 Massachusetts Ave., NW, Washington, DC, 20016.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact: Billie Jo Kaufman, Associate Dean of Library & Information Resources, bkaufman@wcl.american.edu. The bibliography also provides web pointers where applicable (example: Selected ACUS Recommendations continue to be available at a provided university web address).
